note: Real DamDays forecasts. Runway: Tidemark L1 refitted on all answers known by 2026-09-14. Rewind and Rating: the validation season 2013-14, from the model fitted only on answers known before 2009. Scores are validation-period numbers.

coverage.text: 894 farm-like dams (DEA Waterbodies outlines of 0.54 to 4.95 ha that look and behave like farm dams) in NSW Central West. 576 of them have a forecast today; the others are already below a third, have not refilled lately, or have no clear look in the last 60 days. Smaller dams, tanks and bores are not visible.

limits: Only dams of at least about 0.54 ha (6 Landsat pixels) are visible; smaller dams, tanks and bores are not.
Water area, not depth: 'below a third' means below a third of the dam's usual full wet area.
Validation numbers: every score shown was measured on 2009-2015, years the model never learned from. The test years and the sealed region are scored once, separately.

It ranks farms better than it times droughts: the rating tells which cells run dry in a season (ranking accuracy 0.79 within a season), but not which seasons a given cell runs dry (0.52 within a cell's own history, close to a coin toss).

Very wet or very dry years: on 2009-2015 the runway forecasts were too high on average (average forecast 0.27, actual rate 0.24), mostly in the wet 2010-12 years. The likely range (season band) shows how far a wet or dry season can move a chance.
Live forecasts start from each dam's latest clear satellite look; some looks are weeks old.
This is rung L1 of the pre-registered plan (PREREG.md, fallback ladder).
